name: Skill Observability
description: Zero-effort local OpenTelemetry viewing for Claude Code plugin/skill runs and Claude Code's own telemetry. Starts a lightweight in-container OTLP receiver+viewer and wires OTEL_* env vars so Claude Code's telemetry (and any plugin/skill hook spans it or your project emits) export to it.

backend.description: Which local OTLP receiver/viewer to run inside the container. 'otel-tui' is a terminal UI (no forwarded port needed to view it, attach with 'otel-tui-attach'); works on any glibc/Debian/Ubuntu base image. 'otel-desktop-viewer' serves a web UI on uiPort, but its prebuilt Linux binary requires glibc >= 2.38 (e.g. Ubuntu 24.04/'noble', Debian 'trixie'); it will fail to start on glibc 2.36 images such as the common debian:bookworm-based devcontainer base images. 'none' skips installing any local backend (use with 'endpoint' for a remote/cloud backend).

endpoint.description: Remote OTLP/HTTP endpoint base URL (e.g. https://otlp-gateway.example.com). When set, this takes priority over the local backend: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set to this value and 'backend' is ignored for endpoint purposes (the local backend, if any, still starts and can be pointed at manually). Leave empty to use the local backend on 127.0.0.1.

endpointHeaders.description: Value for OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS when using a remote endpoint, e.g. 'Authorization=Bearer xxxx,x-honeycomb-team=xxxx'. Prefer passing this via remoteEnv/localEnv in devcontainer.json rather than baking it into the image; this option exists for convenience when the value is not a secret (e.g. a local collector).

uiPort.description: Port for the local backend's web UI (only used by otel-desktop-viewer). The OTLP HTTP receiver itself always listens on 4318.

claudeTelemetry.description: Set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1 plus OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=otlp and OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp so Claude Code's own metrics and events flow to the local backend.

claudeTraces.description: Also enable Claude Code's beta trace export (CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA=1, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp). Off by default because it is a separate beta signal from Claude Code's default metrics/logs.

logPrompts.description: Set OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1 (and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1) so Claude Code's own OTel events include prompt text and tool parameters. Off by default for privacy.
